  • Constructor Details

    • Family

      public Family(Mouse _fatherMouse, TreeSet<Mouse> _mothersMice) throws FamilyExceptions
      Constructor of the class Family, in which an instance of Mouse and a set of Mouse objects are set as the father and the mothers of the family.
      Parameters:
      _fatherMouse - object of Mouse whose gender must be 'MALE' in order to be established as the father of the family.
      _mothersMice - set of Mouse objects whose genders must be 'FEMALE' in order to be established as the mother/mothers of the family.
      Throws:
      FamilyExceptions - any of the parameters have a gender different to the one they should have or if the tree set of mothers is empty.

    • retrieveMouseFromMothersSet

      protected Mouse retrieveMouseFromMothersSet(int position)
      Method that receives an integer by parameter and converts the tree set into an array in order to have direct access to the elements that are contained in the tree set (we are not accessing them through the tree set as it is not possible, which is why we need to convert the tree set into an array)
      Parameters:
      position - integer that stores the position in which the needed mouse is stored in the tree set of mothers.
      Returns:
      the mouse stored in the "position" position of the array.

    • shouldBeAlive

      public boolean shouldBeAlive(Mouse mouse, int daysPassed)
      Method that receives a mouse and checks whether the mouse received as parameter is more than 2.5 years old. If it is, it returns false (the mouse should die) or returns true otherwise (the mouse can continue living)
      Parameters:
      mouse - Mouse object whose birthday we want to check in order to determine whether it has to die or not.
      Returns:
      true if the mouse can continue living or false if it is too old and needs to die.

    • compareTo

      public final int compareTo(Family family)
      Overridden compareTo method that compares two objects of the class Family and returns a 0 if they are equal or a positive or negative number when they are different. The method is final in order to prevent the child classes of Family to override it.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<Family>
      Parameters:
      family - instance of Family class that we wish to compare
      Returns:
      0 if the objects, according to the equals method, are equal or the difference of the two reference codes of the mice if they are not equal.
